title: lathyrus obovatus
intro: Lathyrus obovatus, commonly known as the purple pea or purple pea vetch, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to Australia and New Zealand. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus obovatus include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus obovatus include isoflavones, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
